title: The golden GAAP balance sheet is shifted one column early: it books the 2018 amortization in the 'BOP 2018' column and puts each year's ending balance under the previous year-end date, so a correct schedule fails.
confirmation: Under headers C32 'BOP 2018' through G32 '12/31/2021', the golden books the 2018 amortization in the BOP column (C33=12480, C34=-113.20, C35=12366.80) and shows F35 (12/31/2020) = 12000 after the 2021 amortization F34=-126.97, with G34=-12000 alone. Each year-end balance therefore sits one column ea
